name: Sankat Mochan Mahabali Hanuman
description: The Show focuses on different and unknown stories of Lord Hanuman, apart from his well-known history as a Ram Bhakt. The show also covers stories about the role of Hanuman in the Mahabharatha.

videos.title: Hanuman Aur Prabhu Shri Ram Ka Milan
videos.overview: The most awaited show of Indian Television, Sankat Mochan MahaVali Hanuman begins with the story of Lord Ram and King Ravan's biggest battle. King Ravan's younger brother Vibhishan meets Jambuvant who is worried for Lord Hanuman, post war. Lord Krishna misses Lord Ram's Param Bhakt Hanuman and desires to meet him and sends Garud Dev with a message. Hanuman teaches an unforgettable lesson to Garud Dev. The most unforgettable moment comes when Hanuman meets Lord Ram.

videos.title: Hanuman's Wish Gets Granted
videos.overview: Hanuman has been a true worshipper of Ram and the Lord seems immensely pleased with his devotion. He asks him what his wish is, to which Hanuman replies that he desires to see him entirely in the form of Ram.

videos.title: Ravan's Attempt At Defeating Hanuman
videos.overview: The Evil king Ravan is baffled when he learns that Hanuman has managed to escape the wrath of the Brahmastra, the weapon that spells death and which is feared by every King and every God including Lord Ram himself. However, Ravan remains confident that the skills that he possesses will definitely give him victory and he proudly announces that he will put an end to Hanuman and his entire Vanar Sena. He then calls for the renowned illusionist, Kaalnimi who has the power to be present in all the three worlds at the same time. Will Kaalnimi succeed in his endeavour to kill the mighty Hanuman?

videos.title: Hanuman To The Rescue
videos.overview: Hanuman approaches Kaalnimi, who is disguised as a sage, and asks his help to select the right herb which is required to save Lakhshman's life. Kaalnimi immediately gets ready to trap Hanuman and he sends him into a lake in order to purify himself but does not reveal to him that the lake spells death for Hanuman. Hanuman innocently takes the advice of the sage and reaches the lake. He takes a dip in it, with his eyes closed and ends up fighting a crocodile. Hanuman slays the reptile but it miraculously turns into a beautiful Apsara named Dhanyamali. Will Dhanyamali reveal the reality of the sage to Hanuman? Will Hanuman manage to bring back the Sanjeevani on time to save Lakhshman's life?

videos.title: Lord Shiva to take the form of Hanuman
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu begins to narrate the tale of Ram bhakt, Hanuman, and starts by how the Gods of the five elements and the sapthrishis in distress, had visited the abode of Lord Vishnu, with a cry for help. As Vishnu finds out that Raavan has made inappropriate use of the boon bestowed by Brahma on him, he decides to bring an end to this demon, himself. He declares that he will be taking the human form of Lord Ram. At the same time, Lord Shiva is seen chanting the name of Lord Ram. Parvati sees him curiously and enquires about this new name that she has heard for the first time. Shiva goes on to explain about Vishnu's divine plan and adds that he too will be a part of this war of good versus evil, as he will be taking the form of Ram bhakt Hanuman. How will Lord Vishnu and Shiva bring an end to the egoistic Raavan?

videos.title: Ram Bhakt Hanuman is Born
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu narrates the tale of Hanuman's confrontation with Shani Dev. While Shani Dev is adamant on entering his body in order to bring out the real effects of Shani into him, Hanuman refuses to give him any place within him as, he declares, that Lord Ram occupies every cell of his body. Shani however, does make an attempt to enter into his head but fails miserably. Lord Vishnu then continues by narrating the tale of Hanuman's birth to one of the divine dancers of the heavens, Punjiksthala. Witness the divine birth of Lord Hanuman here.

videos.title: Tale Of Hanuman's Birth
videos.overview: All the ladies at Vaikunta Loka are left wondering as to how Punjiksthala had a vision of herself giving birth to Hanuman and Vishnu clarifies that Punjiksthala was having a vision of her next birth where she will be born as Anjana, and will be giving birth to a Vanar due to a curse. Vishnu reveals that Punjiksthala was initially given a boon that she will be having a baby although she is an Apsara. As days pass, Punjiksthala tries to forget about this boon, but one day she ends up getting a curse from a sage whose penance she destroys, by mistake. Will this curse too turn out to be a blessing in disguise for Punjiksthala.

videos.title: The Birth Of Hanuman's Mother, Anjana
videos.overview: Narayana is shocked when he finds half of his body submerged into a thick layer of snow. He immediately realizes the power of Ram naam that Hanuman had been chanting all this while, and he asks Hanuman to rescue him. Later, Vishnu once again continues to narrate the tale of Hanuman's birth. Punjiksthala is now reborn as the daughter of Vanar Raj, Kunjar and is known for her beauty and divine, unmatchable skills. But Punjiksthala who is now named, Anjana is still not completely fit to give birth to Hanuman and hence is made to go through several complicated tests, including her encounter with the demon, Shambsadhan.

videos.title: Kesari Slays Shambsadhan
videos.overview: Kesari reaches the abode of the sages. Seeing him, Anjana is mesmerized. She goes on to notice the chain made of Rudraksh, that she had offered to Rishi Brahaspati, around Kesari's neck and immediately understands the divine play of the gods. Meanwhile, the sages plead with Kesari to stop Shambsadhan, who is always trying to ruin their yagna and Kesari agrees to stand guard while the yagna commences.

videos.title: Hanuman's Immense Love For Lord Rama
videos.overview: Kesari and Anjana finally get married and speak to each other just by looking at one another. Vishnu later, narrates the tale of Hanuman's unfathomable devotion towards his Lord. Vishnu narrates the anecdote from Hanuman's life where he innocently pours sindoor over his entire body in order to impress his Lord. Apparently, Hanuman misunderstands the significance of the sindoor that he sees Sita wearing and innocently wears it all over his body to get Lord Rama's attention.

videos.title: Anjana Is Put To Test
videos.overview: As Anjana and Kesari approach Rishi Mathang with their prayer for a baby, he advices them to reach the spot where Vishnu had left his third avatar of Varaha. Anjana and Kesari reach the spot and sincerely pray before the Varaha avatar. Vishnu appears before them in his Varaha avatar and he asks Anjana to do a severe penance in order to impress Lord Shiva. Anjana starts to do the penance and as years pass the warmth of her prayer starts troubling the Gods in the heaven. Goddess Parvathi prays with Shiva to answer Anjana's prayer but Shiva informs her that he has another test for Anjana in his mind. What is this divine test planned by Shiva?

videos.title: Lord Shiva Answers Anjana's Prayers
videos.overview: Seeing the beggar who had approached their doorstep, as a guest returning,  Anjana stops him and welcomes him into her house. She later agrees to serve him all the food that she had cooked, especially for Lord Shiva. The beggar eats up all the food after indulging in regular crticism against Anjana. After finishing his meal the beggar starts to boast about himself and at the same time speaks ill of Lord Shiva. Anjana, who until now had kept calm, gets upset hearing the insult of her Lord, and she starts to defend Shiva against the criticism thrown towards the Lord by the beggar. But Anjana is enthralled when the beggar transforms into Lord Shiva and accepts her long penance.

videos.title: Anjana And Kesari Await The Birth Of Hanuman
videos.overview: After being blessed by Vayu with the boon of a child, Kesari and Anjana thank Lord Shiva for answering their prayer. Days pass and like every other woman, Anjana too is excited about the birth of her child and to help her, goddess Parvathi herself reaches the abode of Anjana and Kesari, in a human form. She blesses the two of them and assures them that their baby will be unique in many ways. Later, Hanuman, who is yet to be born, begins to show signs of power, strength and humour through his mother Anjana.

videos.title: Maa Anjani's Godh Bharai Ceremony
videos.overview: Goddess Saraswati comes to visit Anjana, she comes to her as a Brahmin lady and tells her story. Baby Hanuman talks back to her from inside Anjana's womb. Saptrishis come and tie red thread in and around Kesari's palace in order to protect the unborn Hanuman. Anjana is waiting for village women to come for her Godbarai.

videos.title: Complications Before The Birth Of Hanuman
videos.overview: Anjana's Godh Bharai ceremony continues. Here Goddess Parvati along with Goddess Laxmi and other Goddesses come for her Godh Bharai. They sing and dance on a beautiful song and bless her.

videos.title: Hanuman Takes Birth
videos.overview: Narad tells Vali about Hanuman and Vali determines to kill him, a vaidya prepares poison for him which Vali gives to Anjana in kheer. Anjana gets poisoned and Kesari gets worried. Goddess Laxmi comes to her rescue and saves her. Finally, Hanuman takes birth and both Anjana and Kesari start arguing over a name to be given to the baby when Narad comes and gives him a name.

videos.title: Danger Lingers Around Baby Hanuman
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu narrates the tale of Narayana's birth and his rivalry with his brother, Daksha, who were both born from the creator, Brahma himself. Meanwhile, Hanuman is born and his mother, Anjana, and father, Kesari, cannot stop themselves from admiring their beautiful child. Anjana later announces kheer to be distributed throughout the kingdom in order to mark Hanuman's birth. Vali to receives the kheer but gets furious. He once again makes up his mind to kill baby Hanuman.

videos.title: Hanuman Displays Superhuman Strength
videos.overview: Vali watches as he witnesses baby Hanuman displaying his superhuman strength. Later, Kesari brings along a pair of earrings and a chain for his son. But Anjana gets upset as she is unable to remove the earrings and the Divya Kundal that baby Hanuman was already born with. Kesari is confused as he is unable to see any earrings or necklace adorning his son. Just then, sage Brihspati arrives and makes the couple aware of the importance of the earrings and Divya Kundal that Hanuman was born with. Vali, on the other hand, refuses to give up in his attempts to kill baby Hanuman.

videos.title: The Gifted Child
videos.overview: Everyone panics when they realize that Hanuman Lalla is missing from his bed. After searching for him in the entire room, he crawls in from the other side. No one can believe their eyes when they see a two-week-old baby crawling. Meanwhile, Bali thinks that this child is the enemy of Kishkinda and asks for Sugriv's help in slaying the child. Sugriv tries to reason with his brother.

videos.title: The Divine Mace Reaches Kesari
videos.overview: Sugreev and Vali keenly observe baby Hanuman and when Sugreev learns that Hanuman will be the cause of Vali's end, he gets furious. Meanwhile, Kesari is busy preparing the guest list for baby Hanuman's naming ceremony and is also brushing up his skills. Later, a group of sages approach him with a gift, in the form of a powerful mace. But Kesari is made aware of the fact that he is not the ultimate owner of the mace and he will have to hand it over to the real owner, when time comes. Later, Kesari gets shocked when he sees baby Hanuman on his feet.

videos.title: Sugriv Meets Hanuman Lalla
videos.overview: Hanuman Lalla continues to surprise everyone with his quick growth. Hanuman reveals that he now has two things to celebrate, the child walking and he acquiring a unique mace. Sugriv and Vali are still looking for an opportunity to get their hands on the child. Sugriv finally gets to hold the child and is mesmerized by his smile and innocence.

videos.title: Raavan Cursed
videos.overview: Raavan is hell-bent on meeting Lord Shiva. Nandi stops him in his tracks. Nandi engages in a fight with him as Raavan tries to force his way to see the lord on Mount Kailash. In the heat of the battle, Raavan abuses Nandi that enrages him to curse Raavan.

videos.title: Ravan Prays To Lord Shiva
videos.overview: Bholenath teaches Ravan a lesson because Ravan insults Nandi and Bholenath cannot see anyone disrespecting with his devotees. Ravan's cry makes the universe tremble. Ravan atones and prays to Lord Shiva. Later, baby Hanuman falls off the balcony. Who will save him? Watch this episode of Sankat Mahabali Hanuman to find out.

videos.title: Hanuman's Special Day
videos.overview: It is a special day for Hanuman Lalla as his Nana and Nani arrive in the palace for a special ceremony. Anjana gets worried as she is aware that Hanuman Lalla is capable of some powerful feats. Kishkindha's Richraj along with his two sons, Bali and Sugriv, also visit the palace to congratulate them on the baby.

videos.title: Vali and Sugriv's Schemes
videos.overview: Vali is still trying to apprehend Hanuman Lalla from the palace, before he could succeed, Sugriv finds Lalla and gets enchanted by his presence. Shocked to see an unknown person carrying her baby, Anjana asks Sugriv for an introduction. Instead, Sugriv compliments the baby and hands him over to his mother. An exciting event occurs during the Havan at the palace.

videos.title: Message From Ayodhya
videos.overview: Hanuman Lalla speaks his first words to surprise his mother and father. They are extremely thankful to the Lord for all the happiness and blessings. Meanwhile, a messenger approaches from Ayodhya, who reveals that Dashrath has summoned Hanuman Lalla's father.

videos.title: Vali Is Furious
videos.overview: Vali is furious after witnessing the strength and intelligence of Hanuman, on the other hand, his brother, Sugriva is mesmerized by Hanuman's abilities. King Kesari and Queen Anjana are curious to witness their son chanting Dashrat's son Ram's name.

videos.title: Goddess Gauri Meets Hanuman
videos.overview: King Kesari wants to know how does his son have such miraculous abilities at such a young age. Goddess Gauri wishes to meet Hanuman, she arrives on earth in a disguised avatar with two cows. She informs Queen Anjana and King Kesari that their son is meant to great things in life.

videos.title: Shivansh, Harishwar Or Vedansh?
videos.overview: One by one other Goddesses arrive at King Kesari's palace to meet Hanuman and they start suggesting names for him. But King Kesari informs them that they follow a ritual that the child himself chooses his name. Tune in to witness these important moments of Lord Hanuman's childhood.

videos.title: Saint Vishambhar's Oath
videos.overview: Queen Anjana gets worried after the hide and seek game with Hanuman. Saint Vishambhar, who hasn't spoken since the past 50 years arrives at King Kesari's palace, to bless them. Everyone at Kesari palace prepares themselves for Lord Hanuman's naming ceremony.

videos.title: Hanuman's Naming Ceremony
videos.overview: King Kesari and Queen Anjana get into a dispute about the clothes that he should be wearing for the ceremony. Vali refuses to participate in Hanuman's ceremony. One by one all the guests start arriving for the much awaited moment. Tune in to witness the grand ceremony.

videos.title: Lord Vayu Arrives At The Ceremony
videos.overview: Everyone present at the ceremony start suggesting names for Lord Hanuman one by one. But he doesn't choose any of the suggested names. Lord Vayu arrives and suggests a name. Will Hanuman choose this name or we will have to wait a little longer?

videos.title: Maruti Is My Name
videos.overview: Baalak wants his name to be Maruti. Everyone becomes happy and blesses Maruti. Vaayudev tells everyone that he is only a messenger and Maruti's name was originally chosen by Mata Parvati, Mata Lakshmi and Mata Saraswati together. Maruti's mother tells him that his Kuldevta is Mahadev. Later, everyone sees that Shree Ram is engraved on Maruti's tongue also

videos.title: Praja Darshan
videos.overview: Maruti's mother wants to know what is there in Maruti's Patrika. Vaayudev says that he will be there for him whenever he needs him. Sumeru Praja is anxious to know Yuvraj's name and they go for Praja Darshan. Later, a demon named Vrikshasur who attacks creatures by its shadow and then eats them alive.

videos.title: Vrikshasur's Attack
videos.overview: Vrikshasur starts grabbing Maruti's hands shadow but fails to hurt him and this hurts Vrikshasur's ego and he becomes very angry. He wants to take revenge for his father's death. Later, Maharaj thinks about the incident that happened earlier and gets worried. Maruti's mother tells Maharaj that they should anyhow leave for Kuldevi's darshan tomorrow.

videos.title: Maruti In Trouble?
videos.overview: Anjali prays to Shiva and Gauri and shows her concern regarding Maruti's fast growth. Later, Maruti goes to worship Devi  Lalita Amba. Anjana tells Maruti that Devi Lalita Amba is their Kuldevi. Vrikshasur has planned something evil for Maruti. What is it? Watch this episode of Sankatmochan Mahabali Hanuman to find out.

videos.title: Maruti's Mischievous Tail
videos.overview: Innocent Maruti commands his tail not to hide from him and asks it to obey him. His tail breaks a flowerpot by mistake. Later, Anjana comes in the room and sees the mess Maruti and his tail has made. Sugriva tries to explain to his brother that Maruti is innocent but he doesn't listen to him and starts hitting Sugriva.

videos.title: Bhoo Devi Mantra
videos.overview: Maruti wakes up from his sleep in the middle of the night and calls out to his mother. He starts to call out to Anjani, his mother, who gets worried for his son. Anjani tries to teach Maruti a new mantra, but Maruti is already well versed with it.

videos.title: Hanuman's Tail
videos.overview: Maruti is playing with other "Vanars", but his tail causes trouble for him. Meanwhile, Lord Shiva explains the importance Ram will have in Hanuman's life. Shiva's wife proclaims the role of Maruti's tale, in order to be near to her husband while he is in the Hanuman avatar.

videos.title: Kesari And Hanuman's Mischief
videos.overview: Kesari feels proud after Maruti takes control of his tail. Maruti runs out to share this great news with his friends. Later on, Anjani gets disappointed at Maruti and Kesari, after they both devour the fruits that were kept aside for an offering. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: Vali's Evil Plot
videos.overview: Kesari and Maruti apologise to Anjana after eating all of her fruits. Anjana's heart melts seeing both of them and she imparts an important lesson to her son about creating mischief. Meanwhile, Vali formulates a scheme to trap Maruti with Vrikshasur.

videos.title: Vali And Vrikshasur
videos.overview: Vali overhears Vrikshasur's vow to end Maruti on the night of 'Amavasya'. Vali decides to approach the demon and offers to help him end Maruti's life. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Maruti's Word
videos.overview: Maruti returns home but finds that his mother, Anjana is angry with him because he went out to play, without telling her. Maruti gives his word to his mother that he will never leave the house without telling her. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: Vali's Plan Against Maruti
videos.overview: Vali and Neel team up in order to trap Maruti and bring an end to him. Sugreev sees Vali speak to Neel and understand that Vali is making a plan to harm Maruti. Vali Informs all the children that a grand competition will be held that will test the valour and courage of all. Maruti and the others immediately agree to take part in this competition and agree to reach the spot decided by Vali. Later, Maruti goes home and learns that his mother has prepared a new dress. He gets upset when his father teasingly decides to keep the dress for himself.

videos.title: Maruti Awaits The Competition
videos.overview: Anjana and Kesari explain to Maruti that the true outcome of a competition is not just to decide a winner but to find an opportunity to do one's best and have a good time. Maruti makes up his mind to work hard and have fun during the competition that he is eagerly waiting to take part in. That night, Kesari is unable to help but admire her sleeping child. She later goes to the prayer room and begins to write a few wishes regarding Maruti that she wants to fulfil in the next few days. Meanwhile, Vali speaks to his conscience that warns him against treading the wrong path but he refuses to listen. Will Vali succeed in his endeavor to bring an end to Maruti?

videos.title: Maruti ki Bal Leela
videos.overview: Maruti starts preparing himself for the competition. On waking up, Mata Anjana doesn't find Maruti on his bed and so she anxiously searches for him. She finds everything scattered in the bathroom and assumes Vrikhasur to be responsible for this. She suddenly hears Maruti's voice, turns back and starts laughing at her child's Bal Leela. Meanwhile, Sugriva's brother makes plans to kill Maruti by the hands of Vrikhasur.

videos.title: Vali Is Adamant On Killing Maruti
videos.overview: Maruti is extremely excited about the competition that is about to be held and he requests his mother to let him leave. Anjana orders him to have his milk and he obeys her. However, when Maruti is about to leave, a mirror shatters as it falls onto the ground and this immediately makes Anjana panic as she believes something inauspicious is about to happen. Meanwhile, Vali gets ready to lay his attack on Maruti, but his brother Sugreev tries to stop him. This enrages Vali and he fights his brother until Sugreev falls unconscious. Vali continues to walk towards the spot chosen by him but he is met by his creator, Lord Indra. Will Lord Indra succeed in convincing Vali to leave the path he is about to tread?

videos.title: Ready for the competition
videos.overview: Maruti and his friends march towards the spot where the competition is about to be held and all of them seem to be bursting with energy and joy. Maruti and others make a halt when they are confused as to which road to take. Just then, Vali reaches the scene and leads them to an open area. Maruti gets excited and informs everyone that his mother has got him a new angavastram that he will be wearing during the competition. Vali immediately snatches the Angavastram and decides to return it only if Maruti wins the competition. Will Maruti succeed in getting back his angavastram?

videos.title: Vali Ki Yojna
videos.overview: Maruti arrives early and is waiting patiently for the competition to begin. Meanwhile, Vali makes all arrangements to trap Maruti. Vrikshasur waits patiently to act on their plans to kill Maruti. Will Maruti fall prey to Vrikshasur? What will Vrikshasur do now?

videos.title: Maruti Fights Vrikshasur
videos.overview: Kesari and his men look for Maruti all around, but in vain and this upsets both Anjana and Kesari. Meanwhile, Maruti stands bewildered when he sees Vali struggle to remove his hands from the rock. Initially, Maruti's friends assure him that Vali is capable of removing the hand by himself. But after seeing Vali struggle for a long while, Maruti finally comes to his rescue. To Vali's relief, Maruti picks up the rock with ease and hurls it away. Meanwhile, Kesari gets an army together as he suspects that Maruti has ventured into the forbidden lands and Anjana joins him in this search. Later, as per the rules of the competition set by Vali, Maruti ventures into the cave, unaware that Vrikshasur is awaiting him.

videos.title: Maruti Ki Sankat Mochan Leela
videos.overview: What did Vali and Vrikshasur get by conspiring to take away Maruti's life? What will the end result be now that Vrikshasur is dead and Vali has been defeated? Vali is left shattered and his heart breaks into pieces. Maruti's Santak Mochan Leela shocks three people and the first one is Mata Anjana.

videos.title: Maruti Ke Liye Mrityunjay Jaap
videos.overview: Mata Anjana feels very insecure about Maruti's safety. She decides to organize Mrityunjay Jaap for Maruti. This special puja of Lord Shiva is conducted by 108 sadhus, who chant 1.25 Lakh Mahamrityunjay Mantras. In the meantime, Vali breaks down after his defeat and finds himself in a very pathetic position. His brother Sugreev tries to console him. Will Vali admit his mistake?

videos.title: Ravan Ki Pratigya
videos.overview: Lankesh Ravan calls a meeting of all devil kings to know about the developmental work in their respective provinces. One of the Devil Kings informs Ravan about Vrikshasur's death. Ravan comes to know that Maruti is behind his death. Ravan gets furious on hearing this news and vows to kill Maruti brutally. Can Ravan succeed in his plans?

videos.title: Maruti Ki Adbhut Leela
videos.overview: Mata Anjana feels very insecure about Maruti's safety. She thinks that Maruti's life is in danger, as he has killed the deadly devil Vrikshasur during the competition. This now becomes a matter of discussion beyond Sumeru Rajya border. The king of Devils and Ravan discuss about Maruti. Ravan wants to find out which God is helping this little child who has killed a deadly devil Vrikshasur. For this, Ravan assigns devil Atibal to find out about the God who is helping Maruti.

videos.title: Sugreev Meets Maruti
videos.overview: Kishkinda Naresh Vrikshraj arrives at Sumeru kingdom along with his son Sugreev. Sugreev and Maruti are thrilled to see each other. Maruti's excitement further increases when Vrikshraj gifts him a damru. Meanwhile, Maruti's friends become upset as Maruti is prohibited from leaving the kingdom and they decide to pray to Lord Varuna to help them reunite with him. A while later, Vrikshraj and Kesari are seen discussing about a deadly demon named Chakrasur that arrives in the form of a tornado and ruins everything that comes his way. Will Maruti manage to reunite with his friends? Will Maruti be responsible for Chakrasur's end?

videos.title: Chakrasur Creates Terror
videos.overview: After completing his prayers along with his mother, Maruti is permitted to spend time with his friends. Meanwhile, Vriksharaj and Kesari reach the kingdom of Pampasar and get a warm welcome from King Bhadranath. They all seem unaware of Chakrasur's entry into the kingdom, who means to cause harm to the entire kingdom. Meanwhile, Maruti and his friends admire a bird's love towards its young ones, but they are all horrified when an eagle sweeps away the young ones leaving the mother bird disheartened. Elsewhere, a group starts to conduct prayers to Lord Vishnu unaware of the obstacles that the evil Chakrasur is about to present them with.

videos.title: Maruti Takes Flight
videos.overview: In his endeavor to save the birds young ones, Maruti jumps high and soon starts to fly. He overtakes the eagle and the eagle is forced to drop down the chicks. But before the chicks face any harm, Maruti flies down and catches them. As Maruti's friends stare in wonder, Maruti himself is shocked as he realizes that he has the ability to fly. Meanwhile, Rakshas Kaalnemi arrives at the meeting of the kings, disguised as a King himself and he manages to instigate anger and hatred within the human kings against the Vanar kings.

videos.title: Vayu Dev Turns Maruti's Guru
videos.overview: Maruti, who is on the verge of falling down and hurting himself, is surprised when Vayu Dev reaches the scene and saves him. Meanwhile, Chakrasur continues to terrorize the entire village and shows no mercy on anyone. Vayu Dev goes on to give lessons to Maruti so that he can master the art of flying but Maruti's fidgety mind does not help him concentrate completely. Later, Anjana learns of Vayu Dev's arrival and looks out of the window in search for him. She ends up shocked when she finds Maruti standing on top of a wall, ready to jump.

videos.title: Maruti Takes His Father's Spot
videos.overview: Anjana tries to explain to Vayudev that Maruti is not mature enough to fly, but Vayudev explains to her that she cannot stop Maruti anymore. Anjana enters her chamber and is shocked to find Maruti in the air. Just then, Maruti falls down and Anjana rushes to his aid. Meanwhile, the locals decide to meet Kesari to put forward their problems regarding the terror caused by Chakrasur. The locals however, end up getting disappointed when they learn that Kesari is not in the kingdom. Maruti reaches the scene and decides to help the locals in his father's absence but Anjana stops him. Will Maruti be the one who will rid the locals of the terror caused by Chakrasur?

videos.title: Maruti On A Mission
videos.overview: Maruti believes that he is supposed to be taking his father's place as the king, in his father's absence. After putting on his crown, Maruti flies to the spot where a boy and Apibal are stuck. After rescuing the duo, Maruti takes the boy to his family but Apibal, who has been sent by Raavan, decides to stay where he is. Apibal later, meets Chakrasur and hands him over the message from Raavan. Meanwhile, the locals are surprised to find Maruti amongst them and ask him to stay with them.

videos.title: Maruti Fights Chakrasur
videos.overview: Maruti is caught up in the tornado created by Chakrasur and struggles to escape out. Meanwhile, Kesari's minister tries his best to destroy Chakrasur and bring Maruti to safety but he and his army too are defeated by the powerful Chakrasur. Anjana, on the other hand, prays to lord Shiva for her son but seems unaware of her son being in danger. Will Maruti succeed in defeating Chakrasur and saving the locals?

videos.title: Maruti Challenges Chakrasur
videos.overview: Chakrasur is unable to bear the sound produced by the damru and is forced to flee the scene. Later, the locals decide to take Maruti back to the kingdom but Maruti insists on staying until the locals are completely ridden of Chakrasur and his terror. Maruti asks the locals to join together and form a team to fight Chakrasur. He informs them about Chakrasur's weakness and asks the locals to start preparing damrus. Chakrasur, on the other hand, starts to feel weak and swallows the entire sea to gain strength. Maruti sees this and is worried that Chakrasur might swallow the trees too.

videos.title: Maruti Slays Chakrasur
videos.overview: Athibal decides to warn Chakrasur about Maruti but gets too late. Meanwhile, the locals begin to chant the name of the almighty and hearing this, Chakrasur approaches follows the direction of the divine chantings. He gets ready to destroy the locals but is shocked when the locals start to play the damru until Chakrasur finally meets his demise. At the same time, Anjana hopes that Chakrasur has met his end and decides to have a look at Maruti. Seeing this, Parvathi worries as Maruti is still amongst the locals.

videos.title: Anjana learns of Marutis bravery
videos.overview: Anjana finds Maruti asleep in his chamber and is pleased to see her son asleep. Moments later, she hears the locals chanting the name of Maruti in praises and is surprised. She later learns from the locals and Kesari of Maruti's brave act of slaying the deadly demon, Chakrasur. Anjana is confused but Maruti reaches the scene and clears all her doubts. Anjana goes on to hug her son in adoration and is pleased to learn of her son's bravery. Meanwhile, Narada informs all the Devas of Marutis heroic act and hearing him, Suryadev begins to laugh out loud and refuses to accept the divine powers that Maruti supposedly possesses.

videos.title: Suryadev Grows Egoistic
videos.overview: Maruti begins to play the drum hard and Athibal, who has taken the form of the drum, begins to cry in pain. Maruti finally stops himself when he gets the fragrance of some delicious food that is being served. Meanwhile, Narada is unhappy with Suryadev's egoistic behaviour but reminds him that he will soon have to face reality. Narada makes up his mind to turn Suryadev's day of celebrations to be the day when his ego will be hurt. Meanwhile, Maruti is stopped from partaking the food and this hurts Maruti. Just then, Narada reaches the scene and advices Anjana to complete the rituals the next day, so that he can begin having all the dishes that he wishes to.

videos.title: Maruti's Bhojan Leela
videos.overview: The rituals continue as Maruti begins to get restless seeing the widespread of food all around him. The rituals proceed steadily and Maruti is unable to control his hunger. Yyaspathi goes on to feed the first morsel to Maruti, followed by Anjana and Kesari. Maruti however, is finally allowed to eat and everyone assembled at the place is shocked when he finishes up everything that has been prepared for the day.

videos.title: Mahabali Hanuman Caught Up In Hunger
videos.overview: Maruti wakes up and is extremely hungry. He searches through the entire kitchen but finds nothing but unboiled rice and tries to fill his stomach with that. Even after having apples, he still struggles for more. Devarshi tells him that there is an Aakash Phal in the sky which will give peace to his hungry side. Maruti flies to get that and Devarshi blesses him.

videos.title: Maruti Ki Uddan
videos.overview: Maruti becomes very efficient in his flying skills and flies very high, beyond the boundaries of earth and enters into space. On reaching up high in the universe, he spots the Sun shining bright and finds it very attractive. Maruti thinks that it is a sky fruit or Aakash Fal. Tempted by that, he starts moving fearlessly towards the sun to have it.

videos.title: Maruti Ki Yatra
videos.overview: Maruti is on his journey towards Suryalok and is moving towards his target at a very high speed. He finds the sun very attractive and wants to grab it at any cost. Kaal Dev himself warns Maruti to stop his journey towards Suryalok. However, Maruti is fearless and focused and just wants to reach his target.

videos.title: Kaal Dev Ka Kaal Chakra
videos.overview: Maruti is determined that he will have the Aakash Fal to satisfy his hunger but Kaal Dev creates barriers for him. Kaal Dev warns him of the harsh consequences and puts Maruti in the Kaal Chakra. Meanwhile, Mata Anjana gets worried about Maruti and is unable to find him. She starts praying for his well-being and Kesari sends his soldiers to search for Maruti. Can Maruti break the Kaal Chakra? Will Kaal Dev let Maruti have the Aakash Fal?

videos.title: Kaal Ne Maani Apni Haar
videos.overview: Kaal Dev, who is very proud of his powers and capabilities, is held captive in Maruti's fist. Maruti very tactfully puts Kaal Dev in his captivity. A helpless Kaal Dev promises Maruti that he will not create any barrier in his path and requests Maruti to release him. In the meantime, Surya Dev gets tensed about Maruti's approach towards him. Can Maruti have his Aakash Fal?

videos.title: Varun Dev Ki Ranneeti
videos.overview: Despite all odds, Maruti decides to have the Aakash Fal. He successfully wins over Kaal Dev who tries to stop Maruti from reaching his target. Surya Dev comes in Maruti's way to stop him from reaching the Aakash Fal. Surya Dev, who is the lord of fire tries to stop him by putting fire around Maruti. Can Maruti win over Surya Dev? Can he get his Aakash Fal?

videos.title: Varun Dev Ka Jal Paash
videos.overview: Maruti's decision to have the Aakash Fal is firm and he is mentally prepared to break every barrier which will come his way. His target is fixed and he wants to reach there as soon as possible. However, Varun Dev holds Maruti captive in Himsheela (ice-rock) to stop him from reaching Suryadev. Maruti very easily breaks the Himsheela and proceeds ahead in his journey towards the Aakash Fal.

videos.title: Surya In Danger
videos.overview: As Maruti is about to eat the entire sun, assuming it be the fruit of the sky, Rahu comes in his way as he is supposed to cover the entire sun during the night of Amavasya. Initially, Maruti toys around with Rahu. When he learns that Rahu is trying to fight him, Maruti hurls him and throws him miles away. Rahu reaches Indra's place and cries before him. Meanwhile, Raavan gets furious as he is supposed to get divine powers by the evening, as per the boons bestowed upon him. Since Surya refuses to stop shining, Raavan's boon seems to be useless. Surya, at the same time, makes up his mind to prove himself superior before Maruti.

videos.title: Surya Ka Ahankaar
videos.overview: To fulfil his desire of having the Aakash Fal, Maruti ascends towards the sun. Surya Dev, on the other hand, tries all his tricks to keep himself from being eaten. Other Gods being mere spectators watch the epic battle between Maruti and the Surya Dev. Can Maruti have his Aakash Fal? What will Surya Dev do to stop Maruti? What impact will this epic battle have on mankind?

videos.title: The Divine Play
videos.overview: Maruti finally eats the Aakash Fal. He is delighted as his longing for the Aakash Fal ends. On the other hand, the earth experiences a widespread black out because of little Maruti's divine play. Meanwhile, all the Gods appear in front of Sankat Mochan with a plea that Surya Dev should now be released as his desire has been fulfilled. Will Maruti release Surya Dev?

videos.title: Indradev's Wrath Against Maruti
videos.overview: Maruti returns back home but he faces few obstructions created by Indradev. Indradev sends a white elephant to stop Maruti on his journey towards home. Gajraj or the white elephant cleverly holds Maruti in his trunk but Maruti refuses to attack an innocent animal. Can Maruti befriend Gajraj? What will be Indradev's reaction after knowing this?

videos.title: Indra Dev's Vajr Prahaar
videos.overview: Maruti dogdes the weapons used by Indra Dev to punish him. Indra Dev feels that he has been defeated by a little child and makes up his mind to use the Vajr. Meanwhile, Maa Anjana and Kesari are worried about their child Maruti. Can Maruti be saved by the Vajr Prahaar?

videos.title: Maruti's Descent
videos.overview: Maruti, being stupefied by the Vajr prahaar, descends towards the earth at a very fast pace. God Vishnu and Shiva watch the incidents with patience. Meanwhile, Maa Anjana is in a perplexed stage and starts hallucinating about Maruti. Ravan, on the other hand, seems to be quite happy and praises Rahu for his deeds. Can Maruti be saved? Why are all the gods keeping mum?

videos.title: Anjana Maa's Agony
videos.overview: Anjana Maa desperately tries to reach the place where Maruti is lying lifeless but her efforts fail. Suddenly, Vayudev appears and on his arrival, Anjana Maa starts asking him questions regarding Maruti as Vayudev has taken the responsibility of Maruti's well-being. Vayudev assures Anjana that Maruti will be returned to her in a safe and sound state. He gives her a lotus flower and asks her to hinge her hopes on the lotus, as Maruti will come back to her before it gets withered. Indradev is furious with Vayudev due to Vayudev's pledge.

videos.title: Maa Anjana Ki Peeda
videos.overview: Vayudev holds Maruti in his hands and tries to convince the almighty Bramha, Vishnu, and Mahesh to give Maruti his life back. Indradev questions Vayudev's plea and asks otherwise. Meanwhile, Maa Anjana is hopeful for Maruti's return. Can Vayudev fulfill his pledge? Will Maa Anjana get her son back?

videos.title: Maa Anjana Ki Pratigya
videos.overview: Maa Anjana pledges to destroy the world if her son is not given back. Goddess Saraswati, Lakshmi and Parvati all leave the world taking their valuable powers away and leaving mankind without intellect and money. Bhoodevi also says that if Maruti is not brought back to life, she will make mankind suffer.

videos.title: Maa Anjana's Grief
videos.overview: Devi Parvati, Devi Laskhmi, and Devi Sarswati along with Vayudev, take back the elements given by them to the humans. No living being can live without essential elements. Earth is getting destroyed by the wrath of Maa Anjana. On the other hand, Indradev is still backing his decision. Will the Almighty give Maruti his life back?

videos.title: Srishti Ka Vinash
videos.overview: Vayudev is determined to bring back Maruti's life. In haste, he takes back all the components of Vayu or the air back from the universe. Meanwhile, Indra Dev is firm on his decision to not to give back Maruti's life. Everyone including the Gods in heaven and living beings on earth start feeling suffocated and struggle for their lives. In the meantime, Mata Anjana starts doing Tandav to save her son's life. Will Indra Dev give back Maruti's life? Will Mata Anjana's son Maruti return back?

videos.title: Maruti Ne Phir Jeevan Paya
videos.overview: Vayudev decides to immolate himself if Maruti's life is not given back. All the Gods and Goddesses are worried about the mistake done by Indra Dev. The worried gods go to Brahma and Mahadev to help them out of the situation. In the meantime, Indra Dev realizes his mistake and wants to rectify it. He decides to stop Vayudev by convincing him to not go ahead with his decision of self-immolation. Will Indra Dev succeed in convincing Vayudev? Will Maruti get back his life?

videos.title: Devtao Ka Vardaan
videos.overview: The firm decision of Vayudev force other Gods to give back Maruti's life. Vayudev takes back all the components of air from the earth and decides to immolate himself. Meanwhile, Indra Dev, who now understands his mistake, goes on to seek Tridev's advice and requests them to give back Maruti's life. When Maruti comes back to life, all the Gods including Mahadev and Brahma give him blessings that make him immortal and undefeatable. They also given him a new title and an honor. Want to know what blessing Maruti got from Gods?

videos.title: The Mighty Hanuman
videos.overview: The almighty Shiv and other Gods bless Maruti with their divine powers and make him undefeatable. Maruti is now on his way to meet his mother Anjana who is lying unconscious. Will Anjana wake up? What has been planned by the almighty for Maruti?

videos.title: Maruti Reunites With Family
videos.overview: Maruti returns back home where he gets praised for his safe return. He asks for his mother, Maa Anjana, and rushes inside the castle to know about her well-being but finds her unconscious. Will Maa Anjana ever wake up from her sleep? What will Maruti do now?

videos.title: Maruti Becomes Hanuman
videos.overview: Maruti reunites with his mother and is filled with joy. At this moment, Vayudev tells Devi Anjana and Kesari that by the blessings of the almighty, Maruti has been named as Hanuman and should be called by this name. Can Hanuman use his powers judicially?

videos.title: Anjana's Affection For Hanuman
videos.overview: Vayudev tells Maa Anjana and Kesari about the significance of Hanuman's powers and advises Anjana to make Hanuman learn how to use his powers properly. Meanwhile, Hanuman and his friends are ready to have their dinner.

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Ikchadhaari Roop
videos.overview: Hanuman gives his word to Anjana that he will not use his powers in public. He, however, now feels confused as to how he would learn about his powers. Meanwhile, Raavan uses his powers for bad purposes and evil deeds. Will Hanuman break his promise? What made Raavan this evil?

videos.title: Raavan's Hatred For Hanuman
videos.overview: Anjana scolds Hanuman for breaking his promise of not using his powers in public. Meanwhile, Raavan's mother arrives in Lanka as Kumbhkaran is about to wake up. What does Kumbhkaran want to tell his mother? Will Hanuman listen to Anjana?

videos.title: KumbhKaran Ki Chetavani
videos.overview: Kumbhakaran wakes up and asks for his beloved elder brother, Raavan as he thinks that some danger surrounds Raavan's life. Kaikesi questions Kumbhkaran regarding his dream. Meanwhile, Hanuman is delighted to know that an Utsav is going to be organized. What is the warning that Kumbhkaran wants to convey to Raavan? Will Raavan take it seriously?

videos.title: Kaikesi furious at Raavan
videos.overview: Kaikesi scolds Vibhishana, Raavan and Kumbhkaran as they are unable to get the desired blessings from Almighty Brahma because of which Raavan is still very far from being the ruler of the entire world. Meanwhile, Raavan's man tries to push Hanuman to use his powers. Will Hanuman use his powers? What will Raavan do now?

videos.title: Hanuman Ki Adbhut Baal Leela
videos.overview: Atibal is on a secret assignment to know about the powers which Maruti has received from the Gods. He tries to tempt Hanuman to showcase his powers by convincing him to help mankind. However, Hanuman is taught by Mata Anjana to not to flaunt his powers unnecessarily in front of everyone. In the meantime, the spy of Raavan gets an opportunity when he spots a hot lava erupting from a volcano which spreads downwards in the Sumeru Rajya. Atibal makes it an opportunity to figure out the divine powers which Hanuman possesses. Will Hanuman showcase his powers? Will he understand the motive of Atibal?

videos.title: Hanuman saves his friends
videos.overview: Due to a volcanic eruption, Hanuman gets separated from his friends and tries to find them. Meanwhile, Kaikesi scolds Raavan for his incompetence and advises him to use the power of terror. Can Hanuman save his friends? What will Raavan's next move be?

videos.title: Hanuman Drinks Magma
videos.overview: Hanuman saves the entire village from the effects of a volcanic eruption but it seems like he is in trouble once again. Meanwhile, Raavan organizes a yagya to gain superpowers so that he can conquer the entire world. Can Hanuman get out of trouble? Will Shukracharya make Raavan invincible?

videos.title: Shiva Comes To Cure Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman's body temperature crosses all limits and no one is able to find any cure through which Hanuman can be treated. Meanwhile, Raavan organizes a yagya with the help of which he gets superpowers and become undefeatable. Can Hanuman be cured? Why is Indradev worried?

videos.title: Hanuman Cured By Almighty Shiv
videos.overview: Lord Shiva cures Hanuman and tells him that he should use his powers wisely. Meanwhile, Devraj Indra prepares to launch an attack against Raavan but Almighty Brahma stops him. Will Raavan become undefeatable? Can Anjana teach Hanuman to use his powers correctly?

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Yuvrajabhishek
videos.overview: Anjana tells Hanuman when he should use his powers and the way he should assess the situation. Meanwhile, Raavan acquires the most powerful armour of the entire world because of which he is deemed to be undefeatable. Can Hanuman use his powers judicially? What will be Raavan's first move now?

videos.title: Sumeru's Yuvraj Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman is named as the Yuvraj of Hanuman and the entire Sumeru celebrates his Yurajabhishek. Meanwhile, Urvashi envies Anjana for being the Queen of an Empire and for giving birth to a divine child. Can Hanuman live up to the expectations of his parents?

videos.title: Hanuman Learns To Write
videos.overview: Anjana educates Hanuman and makes him learn the art of writing. Meanwhile, Urvashi approaches Indradev with the demand of calling Anjana aka Punjikasthala back to heaven because her term as a human has come to an end. Will Indradev call Punjikasthala back?

videos.title: Ganesha Wins The Race
videos.overview: Hanuman listens to the epic tale of Lord Ganesha's intellect and how he won the most prestigious competition that ever took place between the Devtas. Hanuman, later, does something which proves him to be a person of great intellect and ethos. Why did Ganesha win? What did Hanuman do?

videos.title: Anjana's Dilemma
videos.overview: Indradev sends Urvashi to bring Anjana aka Punjikasthala back to heaven but Anjana declines her order. After Urvashi returns to SwargLok, Anjana starts thinking about her curse and is worried about the way she will tell Hanuman and Kesari about her departure. Can Anjana tell Hanuman the truth? How will Hanuman react?

videos.title: Apsara Dharm Ka Palan
videos.overview: During a brief discussion between Kesari and Mata Anjana, a piece of sad news arrives which shakes both of them and it reminds Mata Anjana about Urvashi's threat to her of returning back to Swarglok. In the meantime, after knowing about Mata Anjana's decision, Indradev gets a little tensed.

videos.title: Saint furious with Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman tries to save Rishi Lokesh Nath but his efforts prove to be futile as Rishi has been meditating for the last 12 years and Hanuman unknowingly has ruined his endeavour. Meanwhile, Panchnaag reaches Sumeru to kill Hanuman. Will Rishi curse Hanuman?

videos.title: Anjana's Return To Swarg
videos.overview: Anjana is worried about her return to Swarg as she loves Hanuman very much. Indradev now comes to Anjana and demands her return to Swarg but she tries to change Indradev's mind. Meanwhile, Hanuman tries to figure out the reason behind his unending troubles. Can Anjana leave Hanuman?

videos.title: Hanuman Digs Water Well
videos.overview: Kesari orders to dig a big well in Sumeru so that the problem of water shortage can be dealt with. Hanuman also wants to do something for his state and requests Kesari to take him to the place where the well digging work is going on. Hanuman on seeing that some problem has halted the digging process, uses his superpower to dig the well. Why is Atibal seeking Hanuman's help?

videos.title: Hanuman Beats Panchfan
videos.overview: Hanuman beats Panch Fan and this forces the evil snake to leave the battleground. Kesari finds Hanuman and inquiries about his well-being. Kesari finds Panch Fan and comes to know that a fierce battle is going to take place. Why is Hanuman surrounded by his countrymen? What will Kesari do now?

videos.title: Panchfan Infects Entire Sumeru
videos.overview: Panch Fan poisons the entire of Sumeru and even Kesari follows his commands. Hanuman, on the other hand, tries to stop the infected Sumeru citizens from suffering from more damage. Can Hanuman defeat Panch Fan and save the citizens of Sumeru? Why is Anjana praying to Lord Shiva?

videos.title: Panch Fhan
videos.overview: The poisonous and deceptive Panch Fhan starts causing destruction in the Sumeru Rajya. He makes everyone his slave with his deceptive powers. Hanuman's father, Kesari, and his soldiers become Panch Fhan's slave. In the meantime, devil Atibal plans to put Hanuman in Panch Fhan's trap. Will Hanuman come to know about their dubious plans? What will happen when Almighty Hanuman will meet the deadly Panch Fhan? Will Panch Fhan realize his mistake?

videos.title: Vish Ka Prabhav
videos.overview: Everyone including Kesari and his soldiers get affected by the deadly poison of Panch Fhan. However, the deadly and deceptive snake Panch Fhan apologizes for his mistake and suggests a remedy by which hundreds of lives can be saved.

videos.title: Hanuman Fights Jal Datya
videos.overview: Hanuman is on his way to bring the flowers which can cure the damage caused by Panch Fan's poison. He, however, faces certain difficulties because of which his rescue plan gets delayed. Can Hanuman save his country and his father? Why are demons attacking him?

videos.title: Vishelekarni Pushp
videos.overview: Panch Fhan's poison badly affects everyone in Sumeru Rajya. Hanuman's father, Kesari, critically falls ill because of the deadly poison. As per suggestions by a Guru, Hanuman needs to bring the Vishelekarni Pushp to revive all of them from the effects of the poison of Phanch Fhan. However, on reaching Prawal Dwip, Hanuman encounters Brahmarakshas, who want to have Hanuman to satisfy their hunger. Will Hanuman teach him a lesson? Can Hanuman bring the Vishelekarni Pushp?

videos.title: Ravan Ka Bhay
videos.overview: Hanuman brings Vishelekarni Pushp from Parwal Diwp. It revives his father Kesari and several other people of Sumeru Rajya. Everyone is happy for Hanuman, who has helped in saving several lives. Meanwhile, Ravan becomes furious after knowing about Panch Fhan's incident. Moreover, Mata Anjana is heartbroken as she doesn't want to go back to Indralok. According to the orders of Indradev, she must return back on the night of Purnima.

videos.title: Sumeru Par Nayi Sankat
videos.overview: As per Indradev's instruction, Mata Anjana must return back as an apsara to Swarglok. Meanwhile, Kesari and Mata Anjana go to Kul Devi's temple for a special puja. While they offer their prayers to Kul Devi, a Rakshasa spots Mata Anjana and wants to take her along with him. This incident takes place in front of Kesari. Will he teach the Rakshasa a lesson? Will Hanuman come to know about it?

videos.title: Yudya Shiksha Ka Abhyas
videos.overview: Demons surround Kesari and Mata Anjana. They want to take away Mata Anjana and put her into their captivity. Hanuman very playfully challenges those demons to teach them a lesson. In the meantime, Mata Anjana is concerned about Indra Dev's orders, according to which, she will have to return back as Apsara to Swarglok. Will Anjana return back? Will Kesari know about the sufferings of Mata Anjana?

videos.title: Mata Anjana Ki Viwashta
videos.overview: Rakshasas start creating problems in Sumeru. Rajya and Kesari go for a war with them. Meanwhile, Mata Anjana prepares to return back to Swarglok as an Apsara, thus following Indradev's instructions. Mata Anjana feels helpless since she does not want to return back to Swarglok. She starts revisiting her sweet memories, which bring tears to her eyes.

videos.title: Aagyakari Hanuman
videos.overview: Mata Anjana decides to return back to Swarglok. Bounded by the rules of Swarglok, Mata Anjana is forced to take a decision and leave everything back on earth. She goes to Swarglok as an Apsara but is very tensed about Hanuman and Kesari.

videos.title: Swarglok Ke Niyam
videos.overview: Hanuman searches for his mother, Anjana who has gone to Swarglok following the instructions of Indradev. Unaware of the fact, Hanuman goes to search for his mother at every possible place. Meanwhile, Ravan sees a dream where his palace and his province are set on fire. Will Mata Anjana meet Hanuman? Will Ravan's dream come true?

videos.title: Majrika Imitates Anjana
videos.overview: Kesari comes back from battle and brings a gift for Hanuman. Meanwhile, Anjana acts weird and makes Hanuman do wrong things. This behaviour makes Hanuman sad and he thinks about his mother's changed behaviour. Why is Anjana acting in a weird way?

videos.title: Tale Of Nav Durga
videos.overview: Ravan comes to Kaaldev so that he can fight him and win his life. If Ravan defeats Kaaldev, then no one can kill him. Seeing that Raavan will destroy the world, Narad goes to Lord Shiva for help. Shiva tells him that Raavan cannot be defeated and only Hanuman can stop him from causing more damage but he will need the blessings of Aadi Shakti.

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Sankalp
videos.overview: Hanuman pledges to take part in the yagya organized in honour of Nav Durga and fasts to complete his pledge. Meanwhile, Majrika tries to break Hanuman's pledge. Will Majrika be successful? Why is Hanuman looking so sad?

videos.title: Hanuman Gets Nav Durga's Blessings
videos.overview: Hanuman leaves Sumeru with two unknown people to whom he gave his word of allegiance. Suddenly, the mystery couple presents themselves in their real avatars and instead of leaving Sumeru, Hanuman gets more powers to defend it. Who is this mystery couple? Why is Ravan angry?

videos.title: Grahon Ki Dasha
videos.overview: Ravan asks Rahu, Ketu, and Shukracharya to change their places in the Universe so that a chaotic atmosphere can be formed. Meanwhile, Majrika tries to brainwash Kesari by saying that he needs Hanuman to protect Sumeru as Hanuman is more powerful than him. What will happen next? Will Kesari try to injure Hanuman to prove his mettle?

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Yudhabhyas
videos.overview: Majrika poisons Kesari's mind and to prove his strength, he practices in the courtyard. Hanuman also arrives there and asks Kesari to teach him. Things get worse when Hanuman loses control of his weapon and it gets thrown in the direction where Kesari has fallen. Can Hanuman protect Kesari? Why is Indradev along with other planets standing in front of Shiva?

videos.title: Chandradev Changes His Path
videos.overview: Ravan asks Chandradev to deviate from its path as he wants to bring wrath upon the mortal humans. Meanwhile, Hanuman wants Anjana to sing him a lullaby as he is experiencing trouble sleeping. What will Majrika do now? Will Chandradev obey Ravan's command?

videos.title: Hanuman Stops Meteor Shower
videos.overview: The fierce battle between Chandradev and Ravan creates chaos and meteors descend towards the earth. Hanuman tries to save Sumeru by destroying the flying fiery objects. Meanwhile, Ravan defeats Budhdev. Can Ravan be stopped? Why is Hanuman sitting in a cave?

videos.title: Prithvi Par Pralay
videos.overview: Planets are fighting with Ravan to safeguard their freedom but this battle is destroying the calm and serenity of planet earth. Watching all this, Indradev arrives at Kailash to seek help from Lord Shiva. Meanwhile, Hanuman leaves his meditation as he hears Anjana call him to save the world.

videos.title: Reality Of Majrika
videos.overview: Hanuman returns to Sumeru and tries to find Anjana, as it was Anjana's voice which called him for help. Meanwhile, Ravan captures the rest of the planets and compels them to change their regular course so that the earth can be destroyed. Can Hanuman stop Ravan in time?

videos.title: Jagat Gati Hai
videos.overview: Hanuman reaches the moon so that he can defeat the demon trying to torture Chandradev.

videos.title: Chandradev Ki Swatantrata
videos.overview: Hanuman tries to free Chandradev from the evil clutches of Ravan but demons like Meghlochan, Rahu, and Ketu create hurdles for Anjani Putra so that he can stay away from the Nav Grahas. Will Hanuman be able to free Chandradev?

videos.title: Chandradev Ki Shaktiyan
videos.overview: Hanuman teaches a lesson to Raahu and Ketu. He defeats them and returns back all the powers of Chandradev which Raahu and Ketu had withheld with them. Meanwhile, Suryadev is in the bondage of Ravan. Can Hanuman free him? Will Hanuman defeat the devils?

videos.title: Kumbhkaran Ka Krodh
videos.overview: Kumbhkaran throws everything he has at Hanuman, but Hanuman has an answer to all of his attacks. Will Hanuman finally escape Kumbhkaran's grasp?

videos.title: Budh Graha Ki Mukti
videos.overview: Ravan is fuming with anger when Kumbhkaran returns after being defeated by Hanuman. Meanwhile, Hanuman is on his way to Budh to free it from Ravan's grasp.

videos.title: Vichitra Paheli
videos.overview: Hanuman finds himself in a fix that requires him to identify the real Mangal Dev. Will he trust his instincts, or will he fall into an evil trap?

videos.title: Mata Katyayni Ka Vardaan
videos.overview: Hanuman prays to Goddess Katyayani to help him see through the deception. Can Hanuman overcome this obstacle to save Mangal Dev?

videos.title: Pashanasur Ka Ant
videos.overview: Hanuman reaches Shani Grah so that he can free Shanidev but Pashanasur tries to lure him into his trap after which he intends to kill Hanuman. Shanidev, after analysing the situation gives Hanuman a very important advice. What is this advice? Why is Ravan standing in front of Hanuman?

videos.title: Ravan hurts Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman asks for Ravan's blessings as he doesn't know about his identity. Ravan hurts him and says bad things about Lord Vishnu. This makes Hanuman angry and Ravan gets himself into a serious situation. What will Hanuman do? Why does Kesari seem to be angry with Anjana?

videos.title: Gyarah Mukhi Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman fights Ravan but his powers do not do the desired damage as Ravan's divya kavach protects him. Meanwhile, Majrika is in trouble as Atibal, to reveal her true identity, gives her a poison due to which she cannot transform into Anjana for the next couple of hours. What will Hanuman do now? Can he defeat Ravan?

videos.title: Narayan Ka Nar Avtar
videos.overview: Hanuman wants to teach Ravan a lesson by defeating him in a war which is on between the two. In the meantime, all the Gods in heaven are worried that if Ravan gets killed in the war, then the whole idea of God's incarnation in a human body would go in vain.

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Rudra Roop
videos.overview: The furious war between Hanuman and Ravan is stopped by Lord Shiva. Hanuman is in his Rudra Roop making it quite obvious that Ravan would have lost his life in this war. Lord Shiva tries to calm down Hanuman's anger. However, after Ravan leaves the battle ground, Hanuman hears Lord Shiva uttering the name of Lord Shri Ram. This utterance completely soothes and mesmerizes Hanuman who gets lost in his Bhakti.

videos.title: Swarg Ka Dwar
videos.overview: Hanuman tries to break through the doors of heaven because it is the only way for him to meet Anjana. To get past the door, Hanuman needs to answer three difficult questions, every answer will take him one step closer to his mother. What will Hanuman do now? Can he answer the questions correctly?

videos.title: Hanuman reunites with Anjana
videos.overview: Hanuman answers all the questions necessary to enter the realm of heaven and now searches for his mother. Urvashi tries to create hurdles in Hanuman's path but her efforts go in vain and finally Hanuman meets his mother Anjana. Can Hanuman take Anjana home? What will Urvashi do now?

videos.title: Hanuman waits for Indradev
videos.overview: Hanuman is adamant about his decision of taking Anjana back to earth and waits for the arrival of Indradev. Shachi tries to provide comfort to Hanuman and prepares food for him. Meanwhile, Ravan wakes up after seeing his end in one of his dreams. Can Hanuman take Anjana back home? Can Urvashi stop him?

videos.title: Urvashi ka mayajaal
videos.overview: Hanuman searches for Indradev but is unable to find him. After a lot of searching, he finds Airavat, Indradev's mount, who takes him straight to Indradev's palace. Meanwhile, Urvashi, with the help of her charm, hacks Indradev and keeps him busy. Can Hanuman find Indradev? What did Jayant tell Hanuman?

videos.title: Hanuman ka Apraadh
videos.overview: Hanuman sits on the throne of Swarg which makes Indradev furious and he now wants to punish Hanuman for his mistake. On being convicted, Hanuman, to save Jayant, says that he is responsible for his deeds and will accept any punishment given to him. What will happen to Hanuman now?

videos.title: Nyaya Sabha Ka faisla
videos.overview: Indradev tells Hanuman that he will have to present himself in Nyaya Sabha where he will either be punished or be given a pardon. Urvashi is delighted with the statement of Devraj Indra and enjoys the moment. What will happen in Nyaya Sabha? Will Hanuman get the consent of Indradev to take Anjana home?

videos.title: Shrap ki Avadhi
videos.overview: Inspite of what Hanuman does, Anjana is not taken away from swarg and she can only leave swarg when her curse gets revoked. The saint who cursed Anjana in the first place can only undo the effect of his curse. Can Hanuman find a way to convince him?

videos.title: Yakshlok Mein Hanuman
videos.overview: Yakshraj tries to take Uravashi with him but fails as Hanuman comes to save her. When Hanuman makes Yakshraj sweat, Yakshraj tricks Hanuman and disappears with Urvashi. What will Hanuman do now? Can Hanuman free Urvashi and Rishidev from the evil clutches of Yakshraj?

videos.title: Narayan Ka Nar Avatar
videos.overview: Ravan is introduced to a few Rakshasas by his father-in-law. The powerful Rakshasas will only be killed by a God who in incarnated as a human being. The motive of introducing these Rakshasas is to find Narayan who is born on the earth as an avatar.

videos.title: Yakshavyuh
videos.overview: Hanuman is determined to free Urvashi and Rishi Muni from the captivity of Yaksharaj. He very playfully challenges Yaksharaj to try all his powers on him. However, on hearing this, Yaksharaj gets furious and creates a Yakshavyuh to trap Hanuman into it. Can Hanuman break this Yakshavyuh and defeat Yaksharaj?

videos.title: Yakshavyuh Ki Rachna
videos.overview: Hanuman wants to free Urvashi and Rishi Muni from the captivity of Mayavi Yaksharaj but he gets trapped in the Yakshavyuh created by the Yaksharaj. The divine powers of Hanuman are not with him to compete with the powers of Yaksharaj. Hanuman is completely trapped in the Yakshavyuh. Can Hanuman break the trap created by Yaksharaj? Can he defeat Yaksharaj?

videos.title: Yaksharaj Ki Haar
videos.overview: Hanuman is badly trapped in the Yakshavyuh created by the Mayavi Yaksharaj. He tries hard to break free the trap of deadly weapons. At first, Hanuman patiently understands the configurations of the Yakshavyuh. However, on seeing Hanuman break the trap, the greedy Yaksharaj changes the configuration of the Vyuh created by him. Can Hanuman break the trap of deadly weapons? Can he teach Yaksharaj a lesson?

videos.title: Yakshaveer Hanumat
videos.overview: Hanuman encounters a greedy Yaksharaj in the Yakshalok. Urvashi and Rishi Muni are in the captivity of Mayavi Yaksharaj and he wants to free them from his captivity. Later, Hanuman defeats Yaksharaj but Rishi Muni warns Hanuman to not kill him. Want to know why Rishi Muni warned Hanuman? Will Yaksharaj get a Jeevandaan?

videos.title: Daanveer Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman gifts all the Punyas which he has accumulated to the Mayavi Yaksharaj to free Urvashi and Rishi Muni from his captivity. Meanwhile, Kesari comes to know about Majrika's truth and orders to put her in prison. Kesari says that the law council of his royal will now decide her fate. Will Majrika get a death penalty? Has Majrika betrayed Sumeru Rajya?

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Manorat
videos.overview: Hanuman reaches the entrance gate of Swarglok, where Mata Anjana and Devraj Indra along with others wait to welcome Hanuman. It is a very happy moment for him, as his wish to take back his mother Anjana back to Prithvilok is about to be fulfilled. Meanwhile, Kesari is tensed about his wife and Hanuman and so he wants to go to Swarglok. But reaching Swarglok is not an easy task. Rishi Muni suggests him to perform a Lokantaran Yag successfully.

videos.title: Anjana Freed From Curse
videos.overview: Anjana's curse is revoked by the saints and Hanuman completes his quest and now wants to leave for earth but Saptrishi stops him. Meanwhile, Kesari is on the verge of committing suicide. Why does Saptrishi stop Hanuman? Why does Indradev look scared?

videos.title: Indrasan Ki Gareema
videos.overview: Hanuman has been given the option to become the King of Heaven and accept the prestigious Indrasan. Bramhadev is worried about this decision of Saptrishi and seeks counsel of Mahadev. Will Hanuman accept Indrasan? What will be his answer?

videos.title: Naari Ka Samman
videos.overview: Hanuman wants Indradev to give Devi Sachi her place at the throne of Indralok and urges him to be good to her. Watching Hanuman do things with great intellect, Saptrishi asks him to get his powers back. Will Hanuman take his powers back? Who is Vidyutasur?

videos.title: Vajrdhaari Hanuman
videos.overview: After defeating Vidyutsur, Hanuman possess the power to carry Vajr. Indradev makes a copy of his superweapon and gives it to Hanuman. Meanwhile, Ravan tries to make arrangements so that Hanuman is unable to reach Kesari in time. Can Ravan stop Hanuman? Why is Anjana worried?

videos.title: Kesari Ka Kayantran
videos.overview: Kalnemi creates a mist of dark clouds because of which Hanuman cannot see anything and Kesari, who is ready to give away his life, submerges himself in water. Can Hanuman reach Kesari in time? Is this going to be the end of Kesari?

videos.title: Hanuman Revives Kesari
videos.overview: Hanuman tries to give Kesari a new life and uses his power to revive him. The whole of Sumeru along with Indradev and Anjana watch the divine child play his part. Can Hanuman revive Kesari and complete his family? Can his powers help free Marjrika from her curse?

videos.title: Hanuman Ki Shiksha
videos.overview: Hanuman needs a teacher by dusk otherwise he will remain uneducated for eternity. Kesari and Anjana try to find out the ideal teacher for Hanuman but no one can teach such a magnificent boy.

videos.title: Guru Ki Khoj
videos.overview: As per the instructions of Narad Muni, Hanuman leaves to find Maharshri Shringi so that he can get an apt teacher to guide him on the path of life. Meanwhile, Ravan orders his demons to kill every living human child. Can Hanuman convince Shringi to teach him?

videos.title: Gyan Ke Bhandar Suryadev
videos.overview: Rishi Shringi rejects Hanuman's plea of being his teacher and says that Hanuman is a divine child. He says that not even the most knowledgeable scholar can provide him the education he seeks. Shringi calls the Saptrishis to rectify Hanuman's problem. Who will become Hanuman's teacher? What did Saptrishi tell Hanuman?

videos.title: Hanuman Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Hanuman starts his journey to acquire knowledge from Suryadev as no one else can teach him. Suryadev watches Hanuman come his way but plans something else to assess Hanuman's intellect and his worthiness. What has Suryadev planned? Can Hanuman convince Suryadev to teach him?

videos.title: Impatient Hanuman
videos.overview: Suryadev asks Hanuman to stand in line like others and await his turn. Hanuman does as he is said but once again comes in front as the sun is about to set post which, he will not get any teacher. Can Hanuman convince Suryadev? Why is Suryadev angry?

videos.title: Suryadev Lenge Pariksha
videos.overview: Suryadev conducts a test to impart an overall lesson to the divine children in space and for that purpose everyone is asked to complete a task. Hanuman pleads before Suryadev to provide him an opportunity to complete the assigned task. Will Hanuman complete the task?

videos.title: Hanumat Ka Shishya Roop
videos.overview: Hanuman wishes to become a student of Suryadev. In order to qualify to become his student, he gives a tough examination. After knowing Hanuman's answers, Suryadev accepts him as his student.

videos.title: Samay Ka Niyam
videos.overview: Suryadev becomes Hanuman's teacher and takes his first lesson. However, on his very first day, Hanuman reaches his class late. Suryadev agrees to take his first lesson but on certain terms and conditions.

videos.title: Shiksha Ka Pratham Din
videos.overview: Suryadev gives a task to Hanuman. On the very first day of his lesson, he counts all the meteorites in space carrying water in vessels. Seeing the difficulty of the task, Narad Muni offers to help Hanuman. Will Hanuman take his help? Will this make Suryadev angry?

videos.title: Gyan Ka Marg
videos.overview: Hanuman is supposed to complete in order to get his first lesson from his Guru Suryadev. However, he fails to complete the assigned task in the first attempt and gets one more chance to complete the same. Can Hanuman complete the task? Will he be successful?

videos.title: Pakshpat
videos.overview: Hanuman has to complete the task given by Suryadev in order to get his first lessons from his Guru. He very meticulously tries to complete the task within the given timeframe by Suryadev. On the other hand, Varun Dev's son, Gau, feels heartbroken after getting rejected by Suryadev. His mother complains to Varun Dev that Suryadev is being biased and has hence, rejected her son. Varun Dev gets a little skeptical after hearing this from his wife and Narad Muni. She goes straight away to discuss this issue with all Devs.

videos.title: Varundev Ki Aapat Kaleen Sabha
videos.overview: Hanuman tries his best to complete the task assigned by his Guru Suryadev within the given timeframe. Later, Hanuman very aptly counts all the meteorites present in the space and hence successfully completes his task. On the other hand, Varundev calls an urgent meeting with the Devtas to decide whether they need to cancel Hanuman's studentship. He wants his son, Gau, to get educated from Suryadev, as he feels that Suryadev has favoured Hanuman over his son.

videos.title: Hanumat Shiksha Mei Badha
videos.overview: An urgent meeting of all Devtas is called on the request of Varundev to decide Hanuman's education. Varundev alleges that Suryadev has favoured Hanuman over Gau and hence he has purposely not selected his son. It is Raahu who is responsible for poisoning Varundev's mind leading him to become very furious in front of all the Devtas.

videos.title: Kaal Kumbh Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: In the meeting of all the Devtas, it is decided that Hanuman and Gau will compete against each other to prove their mettle, to get teachings from Suryadev. The competition is to enter inside the deadly Kaal Kumbh and both of them have to bring out the hoisted flag within the set deadline. Varun Dev keeps a demand before everyone that Hanuman will have to leave behind his divine powers before competing against his son.

videos.title: Hanuman v/s Gau
videos.overview: Hanuman tries his best to perform all the tasks assigned by Gurudev. On the other hand, Anjana worries about her son Hanuman and approaches Rishiwar. Hanuman faces a new challenge of invisible attackers. Will he succeed in this fight?

videos.title: Pariksha Ka Uddeshya
videos.overview: The competition between Gau and Hanuman begins and the winner gets teachings from Suryadev. The competition is very difficult because they need to come out with the flag hoisted inside Kaal-Kumbh within a set deadline. If anyone among the two is unsuccessful then they can get trapped inside the Kaal-Kumbh. Hanuman very cleverly wins the competition but Gau is stuck inside the Kaal Kumbh and feels very helpless.

videos.title: Hanuman Saves Gav
videos.overview: Hanuman successfully brings out the flag which is hoisted inside Kaal Kumbh. He wins the competition but the very next moment, he hears Gau pleading for help. Hanuman comes out from his Kaal Kumbh and enters the Kaal Kumbh where Gau is stuck and is struggling for his life. Hanuman tries his best to rescue Gau but the barriers present inside the Kaal Kumbh pose a challenge to him. Can Hanuman save Gau's life? Will they come out safely from Kaal Kumbh?

videos.title: Hanuman Ki Vidhiwat Shiksha
videos.overview: Hanuman courageously saves the life of Gau, who is trapped inside the Kaal Kumbh. Hanuman very skilfully bombards the Kaal Kumbh and ultimately successfully escaping from it. Along with Gau, other aspiring students of Suryadev who were previously trapped inside the Kaal Kumbh get released from captivity as well.

videos.title: Mata Anjana Ka Vrat
videos.overview: Mata Anjana is on an Animesh fast, where she needs to continuously stare at the Sun without blinking her eyelids, to pray for the well-being of Hanuman. On successfully completing the fast, Mata Anjana's eyesight gets affected.

videos.title: Stolen Surya Rath
videos.overview: Paatalika creates hurdles with respect to stopping Hanuman's education. Varun Dev and Lankesh build a plan to keep Surya Ratha in Varun Lok. Will Hanuman be able to save the Surya Rath?

videos.title: Maya Yudh
videos.overview: Ravan sends his deceptive army of Rakshaveers to attack Suryalok. Hanuman, Varun Dev, and Sandhya Devi are trapped by those deceptive devils. They try to abduct Sandhya Devi but Hanuman challenges them and wants to teach them a lesson. The Rakshaveers, who have immense deceptive powers, create confusion for Hanuman.

videos.title: Asuro Ki Mayavi Chaal
videos.overview: The deadly and deceptive Rakshaveers are sent by Ravan to attack Suryalok but Hanuman teaches them a lesson. Meanwhile, Varundev becomes furious after knowing that his son, Gav, has lost the competition with Hanuman. He withholds Suryadev's chariot and denies returning it back to Suryadev.

videos.title: Varundev Ki Kutilta
videos.overview: Hanuman is informed by Devrishi that his guru Suryadev is stuck in a problem in Varunlok. Moreover, Suryadev's chariot is also found in Varunlok which Varundev refuses to return back to Suryadev.

videos.title: Mata Anjana Ka Apaharan
videos.overview: Hanuman comes to Varunlok and finds that Varundev is fighting a war with Suryadev and has frozen him with his divine powers. Meanwhile, Pataalika enters Sumeru Rajya and abducts Mata Anjana and a few children from the palace.

videos.title: Patalika Ka Atyachar
videos.overview: Hanuman is informed by Devrishi that his mother is abducted by Patalika and she has been taken along with a few children of Sumeru Rajya to Patal-Lok. Moreover, Patalika tries to perform a deadly yagna, where she scars Mata Anjana and other's lives to make the devil goddess happy. She does this to gain powers by successfully completing the yagna.

videos.title: Paatalika ka sanhaar
videos.overview: Paatalika continuously tries to attack Hanuman and his mother. Hanuman becomes the protection layer of his mother and defeats Paatalika. Meanwhile, Hanuman gets to know about his mother's blindness.

videos.title: Suryakant Mani Ki Talaash
videos.overview: Hanuman searches for Suryakant Mani to help his mother regain her lost eyesight. This task, however, is not easy and his path is full of deceptive mountains.

videos.title: Tridevo Ka Maha Gyan
videos.overview: Hanuman successfully brings Suryakant Mani from the deceptive mountains, which helps Mata Anjana in regaining back her eyesight. However, Varun Dev reminds Hanuman that he shouldn't delay his lesson with Suryadev any longer.

videos.title: Hanuman Ki Guru Shiksha
videos.overview: Hanuman gets his lessons from his Guru Suryadev, where his Guru shares knowledge of divine weapons and talks about its attacking powers. Moreover, Hanuman also gets Narayan gyaan to accomplish his motive of life.

videos.title: Hanuman Ka Mahaveer Swaroop
videos.overview: Hanuman gets his lesson from his Guru Suryadev and learns about the divine knowledge of Tridev's astra. After successfully completing his lesson of Tridev's astra, his guru provides him Mahadev's gyaan.

videos.title: Ram Naam Ki Dhun
videos.overview: Hanuman successfully completes his education and gains divine knowledge from his Guru Suryadev. Hanuman prepares to return back to his home after completing his education.

videos.title: Ram naam
videos.overview: Anjana and Kesari worry about Hanuman's unusual behaviour since he refuses to eat anything and just kept keeps on praising Ram. Meanwhile, Ravan gets to know that Ram is the avatar of Narayan. Anjana and Kesari take Hanuman to Rishiwar to know what happened to their son.

videos.title: Ram Bhakt Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman becomes a Bhakt (or devotee) of Lord Ram and is intoxicated with the Bhakti Ras of his Prabhu. Hanuman is unable to see anything other than his Prabhu and wishes to meet him as soon as possible.

videos.title: Mata Anjana Ki Vivashta
videos.overview: Hanuman gets intoxicated with the Bhakti Ras of Lord Shri Ram causing him to desperately want to meet his Prabhu. On the other hand, Mata Anjana and Kesari think that Hanuman has fallen ill.

videos.title: Putra Ka Daan
videos.overview: Hanuman is intoxicated with the bhakti ras of Lord Shri Ram causing Mata Anjana to believe that he has become ill. Vaidyaraj promises to make Hanuman healthy.

videos.title: Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman is intoxicated in the bhakti ras of Lord Shri Ram. He becomes impatient and wants to meet his Prabhu. He starts flying in the sky, writing Lord Shri Ram's name in the clouds.

videos.title: Bhakt Aur Bhagwan Ka Milan
videos.overview: Lord Shiva carries Hanuman on his shoulders to make a Bhakt meet his Prabhu. However, all the gods from heaven come down on earth to witness this divine meeting.
